_meta.description: Ball Master subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: spell damage, disruption, Breath sustain.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les degats de sorts de 1% et la precision de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases spell damage by 1% and accuracy by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la duree des debuffs infliges de 1% et l'esquive de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases debuff duration inflicted by 1% and evasion by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente le Souffle max de 0.8% et la reduction de temps de recharge de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases max Breath by 0.8% and cooldown reduction by 0.5% per level.
